answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 88 epochs of grading, and every sparrow settlement recomputes the ripple schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 88 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
